description: No credential or login required. Get form attachments. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

atfl_id.description: Attachment file ID (첨부파일 ID). Obtain from forms.list.

bbs_id.description: Board ID (게시판 ID). Obtain from forms.list.

current_page_no.description: List page the target row was found on. Optional; defaults to 1.

pst_sn.description: Post serial number (게시 일련번호). Obtain from forms.list.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
